title: Davis Vantage Reading Rainfall Leaderboard
dataSources: Weather-station observations (`ecowitt:obs`, `weatherflow:obs`), air-quality readings (`purpleair:aqi`, `airgradient:sensor`), soil-moisture/greenhouse sensors, aquarium controllers (`aquarium:sensor`).
app: Personal weather stations (Ecowitt/Ambient/Davis/WeatherFlow), air-quality sensors (PurpleAir/AirGradient), and aquarium/greenhouse/soil sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=davis:vantage rain_mm=*
| stats sum(rain_mm) as total_value, avg(rain_mm) as avg_value by sensor_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks sensor values by total and average rainfall across Davis Vantage reading events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `rain_mm` values for each Davis Vantage reading event and review total and average rainfall by sensor.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total rainfall.
grandmaExplanation: It times which sensor shows the biggest rainfall numbers in your Davis Vantage reading data.
